title: Reports
description: How the fleet was used, what it earned and what it cost

help.title: About reports
help.overview: Utilisation is rented hours divided by the hours a car was not blocked. Revenue is the total of bookings that started in the window.

sections.title: Reading the numbers
items: A search with no free car is counted as lost demand.
Payback is the window's revenue divided by the car's purchase price.
